title: Alpenblick Employee Handbook 2026
author: respondent_668735@alpenblick.com
content: Employee handbook covering all Alpenblick Hospitality policies. Career development policy updated January 2026: all employees are entitled to 5 training days per year. Internal promotion policy: all positions must be advertised internally first. Performance review cycle: bi-annual in June and December.

title: Lucerne Guest Experience Initiative — Technical Spec
author: respondent_668737@alpenblick.com
content: Technical specification for Lucerne check-in system modernization. Current system: Oracle HMS 2014 — end of life. New system: Cloud-based PMS with API integration. Key blocker: legacy Oracle HMS does not support REST API without custom wrapper. Estimated wrapper development: 2 weeks. Owner: respondent_668737.

title: Q2 2026 Survey Results Summary
author: respondent_668735@alpenblick.com
content: Q2 2026 Survey Results. Participants: 22 employees across Lucerne and Freiburg teams. Key findings: Training support lowest score at 3.8/7. Career growth concern across all teams. Manager ratings positive at 5.8/7. Recommendation: urgent investment in L&D program. Next survey: Q3 opens July 7th 2026.
